name: Discovery: Hades Imperium
summary:
Discovery is an open-world tab-target MMORPG inspired by Chinese culture and mythology. Legend says the giant Pan Gu split the heavens from the earth, and when he died his body became the world: its mountains and rivers, its forests, and every herb and mineral that grows from them.

And you can cross all of it in free flight. Take to the skies whenever you want, soar over the peaks and dive into the valleys, in a world that changes around you. Clouds drift across the mountains, rain sweeps over the plains, and snow falls on the frozen north.

That world is now at war. Hades has raised an army of the Soulless that marches across Pan Gu's lands, burning villages and turning the fallen into new soldiers. His hold runs deeper than the battlefield. Hades controls the production of every resource in the world, and no weapon or armor of real power can be made without taking something from him.

You arrive as a newcomer from one of three races and grow into a hero through a story where every quest leads to the next and every level matters. Reach new horizons, unite the three peoples against a common enemy, forge your gear from what you tear away from Hades, and at level 30 choose your path: God or Evil.

Discovery is built to be the next generation of MMORPG engine and game design. It is a Plus experience, made for players who want to enter a world, play, progress, and war for recurses.
